patches.name: 0001-winebus.patch
patches.subject: A USB pad's container comes from its location ID, so a game can pair it with its audio

patches.name: 0002-winecoreaudio.patch
patches.subject: The pad's audio endpoints answer DEVPKEY_Device_ContainerId with the pad's container

patches.name: 0003-mmdevapi.patch
patches.subject: An active endpoint's container is asked of the driver, not read from the registry

patches.name: 0004-winebus-bluetooth.patch
patches.subject: A Bluetooth DualSense or Edge is shown to the game as the same pad on a cable

patches.name: 0005-winecoreaudio-bluetooth.patch
patches.subject: A Bluetooth pad gets the audio output its wired self would have, for its haptics

patches.name: 0006-winebus-xinput-and-triggers.patch
patches.subject: XInput's rumble on the pad's motors, trigger effects chosen in Game Feel, a steadier Bluetooth stream

patches.name: 0007-hidclass-xinput.patch
patches.subject: A pad with a haptics collection is also offered to XInput

patches.name: 0008-xinput-sony-order.patch
patches.subject: XInput reads a Sony pad's own descriptor in Sony's order

patches.name: 0009-mmdevapi-setupapi-endpoints.patch
patches.subject: Audio endpoints are listed through SetupAPI as Windows lists them, with the pad's container

patches.name: 0010-setupapi-base-containerid-wchar.patch
patches.subject: SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyA returns SPDRP_BASE_CONTAINERID as a WCHAR string, as Windows does

patches.name: 0011-xaudio2-mastering-voice-device.patch
patches.subject: An XAudio2 mastering voice opens the device the game names, not the default one

patches.name: 0012-winecoreaudio-edge-output-name.patch
patches.subject: An Edge shown as a DualSense has the DualSense's audio device on a cable too

patches.name: 0013-winebus-dualshock4.patch
patches.subject: The pad shown to a game as a USB DualShock 4 (pad_as=dualshock4)

patches.name: 0014-winebus-trigger-replace-and-live-settings.patch
patches.subject: A chosen trigger effect can replace the game's own, and Game Feel's changes reach a running game

patches.name: 0015-winebus-input-rate-once-a-minute.patch
patches.subject: With diagnostics on, the pad's input rate is logged once a minute, not every 2 s

patches.name: 0016-winebus-rumble-flag-0x02-keeps-the-motors.patch
patches.subject: Over Bluetooth a game report with the rumble flag 0x02 alone keeps the motors, as the pad does on a cable
